Both proclamations quote the same provisions of Title 17 in the same sequence, recite satisfactory official assurances of reciprocal copyright protection including section 1(e) rights, make the same operative determination under sections 9(b) and 1(e), grant foreign citizens all Title 17 benefits subject to the same exception, and reproduce two closely parallel provisos. The child principally adapts this machinery from the Philippines to Israel and changes the effective-date facts and final mechanical-reproduction condition. C18 concerns copyright and Title 17 but uses materially different extension-of-time machinery.
